messages:
nila: Heads-up: intermittent failures in the python sample-app. embeddings.rerank.batch sometimes returns floats and sometimes dicts (e.g. {'id':..., 'score':...}). Breaking our onboarding smoke.

nila: Quick async repro from sample:```py
resp = await client.embeddings.rerank.batch(queries=["where"], docs=[["p1","p2"]])
# observed either -> [[0.88, 0.12]]
# or -> [[{"id":"p1","score":0.88},{"id":"p2","score":0.12}]]
```

jared: Which wheel? This smells like the retry/auth middleware re-parsing the body but skipping the normalizer. Same pattern we saw in the generic batcher.

toni: Agree. The sync path has a normalizer; async+batch retry seems to miss it on some codepaths. Type stubs still say List[List[float]] which is technically wrong if we return dicts.

nila: Observed correlation with token refresh logs during requests. When a 401 triggers refresh+retry we see dicts returned.

toni: Short-term mitigation: add examples/utils.py helper normalize_rerank(rows) used by sample-app to coerce both shapes to scores. e.g.```py
def normalize_rerank(rows):
    return [[(r.get("score") if isinstance(r, dict) else r) for r in row] for row in rows]
```

jared: Long-term: canonicalize at the client's public method boundary (sync+async). Also add include_metadata: bool = False param. Default False => scores-only (backwards compat). If True => return dict rows. Update type stubs accordingly.

toni: Plan for PR: (1) call canonicalizer in embeddings.rerank.batch public entrypoints (sync+async), (2) widen stubs to List[List[Union[float, Mapping[str, Any]]]] temporarily, (3) add include_metadata flag with typed return, (4) unit tests covering retry path and both shapes, (5) update sample-app to use normalize helper during rollout.

nila: Please add a CHANGELOG entry under "Bugfix (python)" so support can point customers to the fix. Also backport to 0.9.x branch.

sdk-bot: Issue created: #3625 - "python: embeddings.rerank.batch inconsistent return shape under retry (async)". CI started.

jared: Also add a tiny example helper in the repo (examples/python/rerank_normalize.py) so integrators can copy it. Mention payload size if include_metadata=True in docs.

toni: Will open PR, include mypy test for the stub change, and ping @jared for typing review.

nila: Thanks 44d once merged I'll re-run sample-app onboarding tests and confirm green.

jared: One more note: ensure the retry wrapper re-applies normalization after a retry/refresh so shape remains stable.

toni: Good catch. Ill add an explicit test that simulates a refresh mid-batch and asserts normalized output.

nila: Great, that should clear the onboarding friction.
